name: Gucci Town
desc:
Explore the beautiful streets inspired by Milan’s historic Brera district where art and fashion come together.

[UPDATE] 
Experience Gucci Valigeria like never before. Play the brand new mini-game and get to the top of the leaderboards for a chance to win limited-edition rewards. 

You can also head over to the new Gucci store to check out Creative Director Sabato De Sarno’s latest collections. 👗
